# Exported API of github.com/writtendev/writ/engine and its public subpackages.
#
# Generated by `make api`; do not edit by hand. `make api-check` fails when
# this file no longer matches the source, so a public API change lands as a
# diff here. A line that changes or disappears is usually a breaking change,
# and so are three kinds of added line: a method added to an exported
# interface; a constant inserted into an iota block, which renumbers the ones
# after it; and a slice, map or func field added to a struct that was
# comparable, which stops every == on it from compiling — and which leaves no
# diff here at all when the field is unexported and the struct already had
# unexported fields. `make api-compat` classifies the delta.

	TargetOpIndex int
	TargetOpSHA string
}

type ResolutionRecord struct {
	ObjectID string `json:"object_id"`
	Anchor resolve.Anchor `json:"anchor"`
	Resolution resolve.Resolution `json:"resolution"`
	Status string `json:"status"`
}

type Scenario struct {
	Name string
	Devices []Device
	Steps []Step
}

type Snapshot struct {
	Objects []ObjectRecord `json:"objects,omitempty"`
	Resolutions []ResolutionRecord `json:"resolutions,omitempty"`
}

type Step interface {
	// unexported methods
}

	Helper()
	Fatalf(format string, args ...any)
	Logf(format string, args ...any)
	TempDir() string
	Skip(args ...any)
}

type Writer struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

type Field struct {
	Name string
	ValueType ValueType
	Strategy string
	Lattice []string
	Key []KeyCol
	Target string
	Deprecated bool
	LeadingComments []string
	TrailingComment *string
	Pos Position
}

type File struct {
	Name string
	Namespace string
	Description string
	Types []*Type
	LeadingComments []string
	Pos Position
	NamespaceTrailingComment *string
	DescriptionTrailingComment *string
	TrailingComments []string
}

type KeyCol struct {
	Name string
	ValueType string
}

type OpBlock struct {
	Ops []OpDecl
	Description string
	Fields []*Field
	LeadingComments []string
	Pos Position
	DescriptionTrailingComment *string
	DanglingComments []string
}

type OpDecl struct {
	OpType string
	OpVersion int64
	Pos Position
}

type Position struct {
	Line int
	Col int
}

type SyntaxError struct {
	File string
	Line int
	Col int
	Msg string
}
func (*SyntaxError) Error() string

type Type struct {
	Name string
	Description string
	Deprecated bool
	Blocks []*OpBlock
	LeadingComments []string
	Pos Position
	DescriptionTrailingComment *string
	DanglingComments []string
}

type ValueType struct {
	Kind ValueTypeKind
	Name string
	Enum []string
	MaxLength int64
}

type ValueTypeKind int

var ErrCycle = fold.ErrCycle

type Anchor = resolve.Anchor

type ObjectState struct {
	ObjectID string `json:"object_id"`
	ObjectType string `json:"object_type,omitempty"`
	TotalOrder []OpRef `json:"total_order"`
	State map[string]any `json:"state"`
	UnknownOps []UnknownOp `json:"unknown_ops,omitempty"`
}

type OpRef struct {
	Commit string `json:"commit"`
	TStar int64 `json:"t_star"`
}

type Rule struct {
	OpType string `json:"op_type,omitempty"`
	OpVersion int64 `json:"op_version,omitempty"`
	Field string `json:"field"`
	Target string `json:"target,omitempty"`
	Strategy string `json:"strategy"`
	Key []string `json:"key,omitempty"`
	Lattice []string `json:"lattice,omitempty"`
	ValueType string `json:"value_type,omitempty"`
	Enum []string `json:"enum,omitempty"`
	MaxLength int64 `json:"max_length,omitempty"`
	KeyTypes map[string]string `json:"key_types,omitempty"`
	ObjectType string `json:"object_type,omitempty"`
	Deprecated bool `json:"deprecated,omitempty"`
}
func (Rule) TargetKey() string

type Schema struct {
	ObjectID string `json:"object_id"`
	Namespace string `json:"namespace,omitempty"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Types []SchemaType `json:"types,omitempty"`
	UnknownOps []UnknownOp `json:"unknown_ops,omitempty"`
}

type SchemaField struct {
	Name string `json:"field"`
	OpType string `json:"op_type"`
	OpVersion int64 `json:"op_version"`
	ValueType string `json:"value_type,omitempty"`
	Enum []string `json:"enum,omitempty"`
	MaxLength int64 `json:"max_length,omitempty"`
	Strategy string `json:"strategy,omitempty"`
	Key []string `json:"key,omitempty"`
	KeyTypes map[string]string `json:"key_types,omitempty"`
	Lattice []string `json:"lattice,omitempty"`
	Target string `json:"target,omitempty"`
	Deprecated bool `json:"deprecated,omitempty"`
}

type SchemaOp struct {
	OpType string `json:"op_type"`
	OpVersion int64 `json:"op_version"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
}

type SchemaType struct {
	Name string `json:"type"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Deprecated bool `json:"deprecated,omitempty"`
	Fields []SchemaField `json:"fields,omitempty"`
	Ops []SchemaOp `json:"ops,omitempty"`
}

type UnknownOp struct {
	Commit string `json:"commit"`
	ObjectType string `json:"object_type"`
	OpType string `json:"op_type"`
	OpVersion int64 `json:"op_version"`
}

type PushResult struct {
	Remote string `json:"remote"`
	Refspec string `json:"refspec"`
	PushedRefs []PushedRef `json:"pushed_refs"`
	Updates []ChainUpdate `json:"updates"`
	RawStdout string `json:"raw_stdout,omitempty"`
	RawStderr string `json:"raw_stderr,omitempty"`
}

type PushStatus string

type PushedRef struct {
	Flag string `json:"flag"`
	FromRef string `json:"from_ref"`
	ToRef string `json:"to_ref"`
	Summary string `json:"summary"`
	Status PushStatus `json:"status"`
}

type RefspecState string

type RefspecStatus struct {
	Remote string `json:"remote"`
	Expected string `json:"expected"`
	Current []string `json:"current"`
	WritEntries []string `json:"writ_entries"`
	State RefspecState `json:"state"`
	Repaired bool `json:"repaired"`
}
func (RefspecStatus) Valid() bool

type Status struct {
	Remote string `json:"remote"`
	Unsynced int `json:"unsynced"`
	ByType []TypeUnsynced `json:"by_type,omitempty"`
	Diverged bool `json:"diverged,omitempty"`
}

type TypeUnsynced struct {
	ObjectType string `json:"object_type"`
	Unsynced int `json:"unsynced"`
}
